item.title: 7. Linear Combinations and Span
item.description:
Linear combinations and span describe “all vectors we can build” from a given set; linear independence tells us when that representation is unique.

Linear combination

A vector $\mathbf{v}$ is a linear combination of ${\mathbf{v}_1, \mathbf{v}_2, \ldots, \mathbf{v}_k}$ if there exist scalars $c_1, \ldots, c_k$ such that:

$$ \mathbf{v} = c_1 \mathbf{v}_1 + c_2 \mathbf{v}_2 + \cdots + c_k \mathbf{v}k = \sum{i=1}^k c_i \mathbf{v}_i $$

Span
